title: HP and Dell see weak PC market as memory prices rise in 2027
html:
HP and Dell, two leading US PC brands, expect memory prices to continue rising in 2027, though at a slower pace, while warning that the PC market will remain weak...

summary: HP and Dell, two leading US PC brands, expect memory prices to continue rising in 2027, though at a slower pace, while warning that the PC market will remain weak.
